description: Election Commission - K. H. Dilip was Selected as the member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
